Card Q&A.a: No. The Digimon is reduced to 0 DP and deleted before this card's inherited effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: This card is a digivolution card in one of my Digimon. An opponent's effect causes that Digimon and another one of my Digimon to reach 0 DP simultaneously. Does this card's inherited effect give the Digimon it's a part of +2000 DP, protecting it from being deleted?

Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon is deleted, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
